summary: McGraw Hill, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its board approved a $50.0 million common stock repurchase plan on June 2, 2026, disclosed alongside fiscal Q4 and full-year results ended March 31, 2026. The buyback authorizes repurchases from time to time with no specific price, premium, or expiration terms set forth. The board authorized the plan; no external advisors or transaction mechanics are detailed. As a capital return to shareholders via open-market repurchases, this is a discretionary capital-allocation action. Watch for periodic repurchase disclosures and any impact on share float or EPS accretion.
